note: Weigand camping area of Lewis and Clark SRA (the park headquarters) on the 16-mile Lewis and Clark Lake (Missouri River reservoir) north of Crofton. Paved pads, many shaded; the lakefront row on the lake side of the loop backs onto the shore through a patchy treeline. Coin showers and a playground; the Burbach campground is a separate loop 1.6 km west. Weigand Marina slips and boat ramp closed for marina construction from September 10, 2025 through 2026 (camping not affected). --Claude
summary: RA confirms Weigand Modern: 59 paved RV sites (30 Electric 30 A, 26 Electric Plus 50 A, 3 Full Hookup), 50-ft max, 10 pull-through, 14 tagged Lakefront, coin showers, dump, 180-day window; quotes Apr 2027 $25/$30/$35. Fees re-based 10-15 -> 20-35 (every RV site electric; off-season $5 less), surcharges cleared. Count 192 (whole park) cleared. Pin OK (~130 m from the loop centre). Lakefront stands (RA per-site flag + imagery). Phone (402) 388-4169 to add.

The stored evidence string is only a pointer to commit 3126a2b; suggest replacing it with this.

SPLIT / DUPLICATE LEAD (no split made): the park's other RA campground, BURBACH CAMPGROUND (61 reservable sites: 34 Electric Plus 50 A, 27 Electric 30 A, 19 gravel, plus non-electric gravel pads per the park page), centres at 42.83668,-97.59136, about 1.6 km west of the Weigand Modern centre (42.83545,-97.57220), on its own spur off the park road with the swim beach and dump station. It is already covered by entry 2707 'Lewis and Clark State Recreation Area (Weigand-Burbach)', but 2707's pin (42.8410,-97.6140) is about 1.9 km west of the Burbach sites, on the shore by a residential lot area, not at any campground. Suggest 2707 be renamed to Burbach and re-pinned to 42.83668,-97.59136 (its 'Weigand-Burbach' name and '~190+ sites' note duplicate this entry). Bloomfield (2673) is a separate area further west.
Weigand Marina slips and boat ramp closed Sept 10, 2025 through 2026 for construction (RA alert); camping not affected, put in the note.
